title: Every lifecycle event carries a metadata-only whitelist with no body bytes, no header values and no consumer context
asA: developer whose queue traffic may carry PII bodies
iWant: the lifecycle event whitelist to be enforced in code so my consumer logging cannot accidentally leak a body byte, a header value, or a consumer-context field
soThat: the shipped shape composes with a PII-bearing body without redaction gymnastics at every log site

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the SIMULATE_PII_IN_BODY=true induced-failure switch driving publish and ack with a PII fixture body (userId 1234, ssn 123-45-6789), when the event-secrecy probe captures the events, then every event record carries exactly the whitelist fields (event, messageId, queueName, attempts, timestamp) and no more; no body bytes, no header value, no userId string, no ssn string, no consumer-context field appears in any record, verified by JSON-stringify substring grep.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the PII fixture body driven through publish, consume and ack
acceptanceCriteria.when: the event-secrecy probe reads the captured event records
acceptanceCriteria.then: every record carries only the whitelist; JSON-stringify substring grep for the fixture PII strings returns no match on any record
